description: Returns the full EU Deforestation Regulation (EUDR) Annex I product catalogue: each commodity with its CN codes and descriptions, from the official acts. Use it to browse what is covered; use eudr_check_scope to test one code and get a clear verdict. No inputs; no paging. Output: products[] (commodity, codes, descriptions; lines added by Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/2102 carry applies_from 2027-12-30), removed products, applies_from dates, official sources and verified. Ex lines cover only the described goods, not everything under the code. Bundled from the official acts and reviewed as of verified. Terms: read-only; MCP calls are never charged. Without a key, metered routes give 10 successful answers a day free, as short samples (up to 3 records, without file proof, history or paging cursor) where a paid HTTP address exists (unmetered routes are unlimited); errors do not count. On the paid HTTP routes, errors are free, and so are empty answers except a sanctions name search with no match when every loaded list it checks is fresh (lists not loaded yet are named in the answer). An optional API key keeps its prepaid-credit policy. When the free answers run out, the error names the HTTP alternative.
name: eudr_list_products
title: List EUDR products in scope
